answer: Each agent must hold exclusive title to one numbered pearl farm raft concession—the coast authority issues only a fixed count per season—and lock a slashable bond to that lease. Inspectors arrive unannounced after dark, carry a lantern down the walkway, and match the ferrous cage serial welded to the raft against the concession ledger, then accept a signed nonce from the lease-bound key. A reused serial or empty mooring burns the bond. Each fake identity costs another auctioned concession, another registered cage, and another full deposit, which rises as remaining plots are bid away.
